{{Top}}
[[File:Scythe_class_profile.jpg|250px|thumb|The ''Scythe''-class served in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]].]]
{{Quote|This is my personal battle cruiser&hellip;and I did not name it the ''Executor'' for nothing!|Darth Vader, referring to his [[Executor/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]|<ref name="Doom">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref>}}
'''Battlecruiser''', or '''battle cruiser''', was a formal designation for the class of massive ships that fell between [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]] in size.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> In informal use, it was used for the largest and strongest warships in a fleet that were not [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]], as well as more generally for various types of warships, along with "[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]."<ref name="SOR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Nova-classBattleCruiser-SotGSE.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Nova''-class of the Hapes Consortium.]]
Informally, the term "battlecruiser" had been used for centuries to refer to any massive, heavily armored battleship designed for the single purpose of destroying other [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Due to different naming customs and design-capabilities, some vessels bore the designation of "battlecruiser" while serving as [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-analogs on a galactic scale, like the [[Kaloth-style battlecruiser|''Kaloth''-style battlecruiser]]<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> and the Hapes-built [[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruiser]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> Others were comparable in role to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], like the [[Centurion-class battlecruiser/Legends|''Centurion''-class]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]] employed by the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]].<ref name="SWL0½">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0½|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0½]]</ref> Some military historians were prepared to argue that a few legendary ships of the ancient [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], such as [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] ''[[Eibon Scimitar]]'' and the ''[[Bloodshield]]'' of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], should qualify as battlecruisers.<ref name="EGTW" />

Under the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]], however, the term "battlecruiser" was reserved for capital ships measuring between two thousand and five thousand meters in length and designed for long-range, independent operations. Most battlecruisers were large and powerful ships that were among the most powerful in their fleets. A prime example was the [[Tagge battlecruiser]]s used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="SW31">[[Star Wars (1977) 31|''Star Wars'' (1977) 31]]</ref> as well as the [[Mediator-class battle cruiser]] first deployed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> Most accepted that the first warship that could be formally recognised as a battlecruiser was [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]' 2.5-kilometer [[Procurator-class Star Battlecruiser|''Procurator''-class battlecruiser]], launched some two hundred years before the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The heavily-armed design impressed many wealthy [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and mercantile fleets, and by the time of the Clone Wars, dozens of battlecruisers had been built and filled the [[Planetary Security Forces]] of Core and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] sectors.<ref name="EGTW" />

The ''Procurator''-class design was refined several times before being supplanted by the four-thousand-meter [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class]], though the warship limitations of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] limited both classes' [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] to local charts. When the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was restored during the Clone Wars, however, the majority of battlecruisers found their way into Republic service. Most defended the Core Worlds against the possibility of the [[Bulwark Fleet]] breaking out from [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], or the massive battleships [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] and ''[[Devastation]]'' breaking into the Core, but some were uparmored, fitted with powerful new hyperdrives, and became the spearheads of task forces sent against key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] worlds, such as the ''[[Quaestor]]'' at [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] would commission relatively few battlecruisers. Strategists saw them as less versatile and more expensive than [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] while not instilling the same terror as [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]]. The Empire operated a handful of smaller battlecruisers known as [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]], but few recognised this as a formal capital ship class. The Empire primarily used battlecruisers to defend key areas in the Core Worlds, though some acted as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] of task forces undertaking dangerous missions on the fringes of Imperial space, such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel]]'s [[Helmsman (battlecruiser)|''Helmsman'']].<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="JFT11">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/24881617404/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-11|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 11}}</ref>

==Known battlecruiser designs==
===[[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]]===
Often nicknamed a "Heavy Star Destroyer," it was a 2,200m vessel that saw service throughout the Empire, and was also utilized within the reborn Emperor's empire. It also acted as a good example of the cruiser subclass of battlecruiser.

[[File:BulwarkBattlecruiser-SWR.png|thumb|The ''Bulwark''-class came in different models with increasing sizes.]]

===''Bulwark''-class battle cruiser===
The ''Bulwark''-class was used for a series of battlecruiser designs from [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated|TransGalMeg Industries]]. The 1 kilometer long [[Bulwark Mark I]] served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], while a later, larger [[Bulwark Mark III|model]] was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]].

===[[Centurion-class battlecruiser/Legends|''Centurion''-class battlecruiser]]===
The 1,200 meter long ''Centurion''-class served as command ships in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]], taking the role earlier filled by the larger [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class tactical command ships]].

===[[Kaloth-style battlecruiser|''Kaloth''-style battlecruiser]]===
The 307 meter ''Kaloth''-class was a small warship built by the [[Kaloth]]. It was only used by pirates and slavers a few decades after its introduction.

[[File:Ravager5.jpg|thumb|A dilapidated ''Centurion''-class battlecruiser in formation with [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruisers]].]]

===[[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator''-class battle cruiser]]===
The ''Mediator''-class was a heavy warship that was built and fielded by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. It was only eclipsed in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] service by their [[Star Defender]]s and [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]].

===[[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruiser]]===
The 400 meter ''Nova''-class was a light [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes]] warship used to support the [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s.

===[[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class battlecruiser]]===
The ''Praetor''-class was a heavy Imperial warship with reactor equipment that eclipsed that on contemporary [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] designs.

===[[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]]===
The ''Praetor Mark II''-class was an Imperial battlecruiser designed and unveiled during the early stages of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] formation. Few were made largely due to the costs, lack of versatility, and lack of a terror-inducing shape of the Star Destroyers and the Star Dreadnoughts, respectively.

===[[Procurator-class Star Battlecruiser|''Procurator''-class Star Battlecruiser]]===
The ''Procurator''-class was a heavy design that protected the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] alongside their [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]].

===[[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]]===
The ''Scythe''-class was a heavily armed and armored battlecruiser design, serving in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. It was well-armored enough to withstand barrages of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire from multiple [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigates]].

===[[Shree-class battle cruiser|''Shree''-class battle cruiser]]===
[[File:Shriwirr-TBSB.jpg|thumb|The ''Shree''-class led the fleets of the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]].]]
The main warship of the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]], the 900 meter long ''Shree''-class was a rounded warship design that could hold 500 [[Swarm-class battle droid|''Swarm''-class battle droids]].

===[[Tagge battlecruiser]]===
This line of battlecruisers, which possessed a similar design to the ''Star Destroyer''-class, belonged to the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] and was pledged to aid the Imperial warships blockading the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The presence of the Tagge warships and their commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge]], allowed family patriarch [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] to conduct private operations under the Empire's radar.

==Behind the scenes==
In Naval terms, battlecruisers are a type of naval warship that acted as an intermediary between battleships and cruisers. Namely, possessing a battleship's armament but with lighter armor while retaining most of a cruiser's speed and maneuverability. They were prevalent during the first half of the 20th century, although by the end of World War II and the beginning of the Cold War, they fell into disuse.

According to Jason Fry's Endnotes for ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', the battlecruisers were "neither fish nor fowl", although he had fun going back to Giel's previously unnamed flagship, the ''Helmsman''.
